{{Quote|You can find him with his girlfriend. She has a place on the upper east side of our happy land.|[[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]]|<ref name="LL" />}}
"'''Happyland'''" was an area of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. Though it had highrise towers in some areas, it was still considered part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].<ref name="LL" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] named [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] maintained an [[Nack Movers's residence/Legends|apartment]] in Happyland's upper east side. Marcy murdered her boyfriend, [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], in the apartment with the aide of her partner in crime, [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]]. They were discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who notified the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] which arrived at the apartment to investigate. There, they discovered [[Nack Movers/Legends|Movers]]' body and Ione, who was apparently mourning him. She asked Sinube if the men who supposedly killed Nack had left. Sinube's response was yes, but Ahsoka still went to search the bedroom. There, she discovered Ione's partner-in-crime; [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], who had Ahsoka's lightsaber. She soon after escaped out the window, and Ahsoka followed her. Meanwhile Sinube worked out that Ione was in league with Cassie.<ref name="LL" />
